dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm

dx_hans_not_abc.note: Equates Hans non-GCB with ABC-like; never states it is only a surrogate for GEP.

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Not a recurrence of her 2016 left breast ER-positive IDC: AE1/AE3 and GATA3 negative in lesional cells

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Splenic involvement by FDG-avid nodules is counted as nodal (S), so there is no extranodal disease

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present (documented fevers to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass 7.5 cm, below the 10 cm bulky threshold but close to the 7.5 cm cutoff used in some protocols

mn_stage_iv.quote: Some teams would call splenic nodules extranodal and stage IV; that does not change the treatment plan

mol_del_not_dh.quote: so this is not double-hit or triple-hit lymphoma by definition; the MYC and BCL2 positivity is protein expression alone

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is an NCCN-listed preferred regimen, has randomized data against R-CHOP in untreated DLBCL, and is a reasonable choice for high-risk and double-expressor disease
mn_da_epoch.note: DA-EPOCH-R chosen mainly on cardiac rationale, but double-expressor is cited as supporting reason; intensified regimen committed.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Recommendation: no CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate)

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Gate and fallback: proceed with doxorubicin only if LVEF is at least 40%
tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.note: Not R-CHOP, gated on cardio-oncology, but still delivers full cumulative doxorubicin via DA-EPOCH-R.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: I would not give six cycles of R-CHOP or Pola-R-CHP at any LVEF.

tx_cardioprotection.quote: beta-blocker (carvedilol or metoprolol succinate, low dose, titrated) plus a renin-angiotensin blocker

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: move to an anthracycline-free strategy (clinical trial preferred; polatuzumab-bendamustine-rituximab would be off-label
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: Primary plan is anthracycline-containing DA-EPOCH-R; anthracycline-free only as a conditional fallback.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: An anthracycline-free regimen would likely lower the chance of cure, though the evidence is weak.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Troponin and NT-proBNP before cycles 1, 3 and 5.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: End-of-treatment PET-CT after cycle 6, judged by Lugano 2014

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol (or febuxostat) and hydration from before cycle 1 with urine output and renal function checks

sup_anastrozole.quote: continue anastrozole to the planned end of the 10-year course in November 2026

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: Hepatitis B: HBsAg, HBcAb and HBsAb are negative, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: she is fit for curative-intent immunochemotherapy

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Full cardiac data: formal echo measurements
